notes: Computer pilots for practice matches. Each level sets how well a bot aims and how fast it reacts. aim_rate_deg is how fast it can swing its aim, aim_error_deg a random wobble on it, lead how well it aims ahead of a moving target (0 to 1), fire_range is the fraction of a weapon's range it will shoot at, reaction is the pause in seconds before it opens fire on a new target, and dodge is how often (0 to 1) it changes strafe direction.
